description.value:
You use your comm unit as a focus for communication, projecting messages to those nearby. You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet by using a free hand to type a message into your comm unit or whispering into the mic. This communication is one-way, and you can only communicate with creatures that share a language with you. You can choose which creatures receive your communications, and those creatures know you were the one who transmitted the message.

Heightened (5th) You can communicate with images rather than words. Instant messaging loses the linguistic trait.

system.requirements: You have a comm unit or other long-range communications device, used as a locus.
